meta.name: pyqt-dialogs-and-validation
meta.description: Standardize field validation and error presentation in PyQt forms and dialogs. Use when validation is inconsistent or duplicated.

copy.tagline: 统一 PyQt 表单验证与错误提示
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果在 PyQt 项目中需要标准化字段验证和错误展示。
copy.tagline_en: Standardize validation and error display in PyQt forms
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need consistent field validation and error presentation in PyQt projects.

howto.what: Claude 会帮你规范 PyQt 表单中的字段验证和错误提示，把界面层和业务层的验证逻辑分开，并生成验证流程和消息显示策略。
howto.when: 当你在 PyQt 项目中遇到验证不一致或重复的代码时，或者需要设计表单验证和错误提示方案时触发。

say.text: 帮我规范这个 PyQt 登录表单的字段验证。
say.note: Claude 会分析表单并生成验证方案。

say.text: 为我的 PyQt 对话框设计统一的错误提示策略。
say.note: Claude 会输出消息显示策略。

howto.what_en: Claude helps you standardize field validation and error presentation in PyQt forms and dialogs, cleanly separating UI-level and domain-level validation, and produces a validation flow and message display policy.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you encounter inconsistent or duplicated validation in PyQt projects, or need to design form validation and error presentation.

say_en.text: Standardize the field validation for this PyQt login form.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze the form and generate a validation plan.

say_en.text: Design a unified error presentation strategy for my PyQt dialogs.
say_en.note: Claude will output a message display policy.
